newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London little changed, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London little changed, trade thin.

text.p: U.S. shares were little changed from New York closing levels as most European investors started their Christmas holidays early, dealers said. "Most of the year-end window dressing has been completed. People just want this year to fade away and will start doing business in the New Year," one market-maker said.

The Dow industrials average finished 4.62 points higher on Monday at 6,489.02, but many players were absent due to the approaching holidays, dealers said. Wall Street will have a shortened session on Tuesday, with the New York Stock Exchange closing at 1800 GMT/1300 EST.
